name: Delivery & Beyond
detailed_description:
Break In. Scrap. Deliver.

Your delivery company signed you up for a massive contract… but forgot the small detail of providing actual packages.

So your crew came up with a “perfectly reasonable” solution: break into places while everyone’s away, scrap whatever you find, and build the orders yourself.

Key Features:

  • Improvised Deliveries – Smash furniture, gadgets, and odd décor into parts, then craft the bizarre orders your clients demand.

  • Fast-Paced Co-op Chaos – Work together to grab scrap, build deliveries, and escape before the cops arrive.

  • Beat the Timer – Every run is a race against the ticking clock. Stay too long, and the zebra police will storm the building!

  • Procedurally Generated Runs – Fresh layouts, items, and surprises every time you play.

  • Ridiculous Orders – “Suspicious soup.” “Vintage hat stacks.” “Golden pyramid lamps.” If you can build it, you can ship it.

  • Upgrades & Oddities – Use your earnings to buy faster tools, sillier costumes, and strange gadgets—because your debt’s not going anywhere.

  • Debt That Never Ends – Every contract just raises the amount you owe for the next one. You’re not here to get rich—you’re here to keep the collectors off your back for one more round.

It’s not theft… if it was never really there in the first place.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10/11
  • Processor: 2 GHz Processor or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
